description: Shared capability record contracts for PAI V2. Five versioned record kinds cover the universal capability layer: perception observations (camera/screen/OCR/model description with truthful distance semantics), bounded MK-style environment learning (observations vs hypotheses vs corrections vs verified facts, with provenance), procedure outcomes (preconditions/postconditions/verification/promotion), audio backend status (honest backend identity, never synthetic-labeled production), and device capability manifests (discovery evidence + verification state; control requires a verified adapter). Enforced invariants live in the Rust crate (packages/capability-contracts) and are restated here per record.

perception_observation.description: One structured perception result from a camera frame, screen capture, OCR pass, or model image description. Detector labels and model descriptions are DISTINCT: a description is a hypothesis with provenance, never a detector class.

fields.model_identity: deterministic model identity, e.g. efficientdet-lite2-int8 (asset sha256-pinned) or gemma-4-12b@mmproj; null for raw sensor data
fields.labels: array of {label, confidence: 0..1, box: {x,y,width,height} normalized 0..1, track_id?, track_uncertain?}
fields.ocr_text: optional OCR text — kept distinct from detection labels
fields.description: optional free-text model description (hypothesis; requires provenance)
fields.distance: optional {kind: apparent_size_cue | calibrated_meters, value, evidence} — apparent_size_cue is NEVER metres; calibrated_meters requires a supported, calibrated sensor named in evidence

invariants: distance.kind=calibrated_meters requires non-empty evidence naming the sensor
description requires provenance; a description is never a verified detector class
track_uncertain defaults true after occlusion or long gaps (detector-based tracking only)

distance.evidence: bounding-box fill ratio of the frame; not calibrated distance

environment_observation.description: One learned environment fact about a device, scene, or host capability. The epistemic status is mandatory: observations require provenance, hypotheses are never trusted for control, corrections override prior records, verified facts require verification evidence.

fields.subject: device/scene identity fingerprint (stable per device or scene)
fields.evidence: the measured evidence behind this record (never appearance-only inference)
fields.scope: device | user | project (scopes stay isolated; one scope never leaks into another)
fields.provenance: {platform, device_id, source: which sensor/adapter/service produced it}
fields.verification_ref: required when epistemic_status=verified_fact: reference to the verification evidence (procedure outcome id, adapter check, measurement)

invariants: hypothesis records are never promoted to device-control authority
correction records supersede earlier records on the same subject+capability
evidence must be measured, not inferred from appearance alone

example.subject: vault-drive-<fingerprint>
example.evidence: Windows removable-drive enumeration reports a validated UNOONE package; manifest PackageIdentity check passed

procedure_outcome.description: One bounded record of a procedure attempt (tool call or skill execution) with preconditions, postconditions, verification evidence, risk class, and promotion status. This is the MK-style learning record: repeatable low-risk procedures with verified postconditions become promotion candidates, never automatically promoted.

fields.procedure_id: canonical tool id (tools.v1.json) or skill signature
fields.bounded_arguments: bounded summary of the arguments (no unbounded payloads)
fields.preconditions: what had to hold before the call
fields.verification: {verified: bool, evidence: what was actually observed after the action}
fields.risk_class: DIRECT | CONFIRM | STRONG_CONFIRM | BLOCK (matches the tool contract)
fields.promotion: {status: none | suggested | approved | rejected, policy_version, requirements: the gates that must ALL hold}

invariants: promotion.status=approved requires ALL requirements: bounded_arguments, repeatable_success, verified_postconditions, low risk class, no_contradictory_evidence, explicit_approval
result=success without verification.verified is NOT promotion evidence
promotion.status=suggested never auto-executes; approval is explicit user or policy action

example.postconditions: calendar app is the foreground activity

verification.evidence: ActionVerifier: foreground package == default calendar provider

audio_backend_status.description: Honest audio backend identity per capability. Reference/scaffold engines must be labeled as such — never presented as production ASR/TTS. Backend identity, readiness, streaming class, and offline status are the cross-platform contract fields.

fields.backend: sherpa-onnx | inbharat-audio | whisper-cpp | piper | android-system-tts | reference | unavailable
fields.offline: bool — true only when the backend runs fully offline

invariants: backend=reference is scaffold/reference output and must never be reported as production ASR/TTS
backend=android-system-tts or android-system-stt is online-ish emergency fallback: offline=false
ready=false plus reason is the fail-closed contract — never silently fall back

device_capability.description: Host-side device adapter manifest entry: what PAI can actually discover and support. USB presence alone grants nothing; control operations require a verified adapter.

fields.supported_operations: array of operation names the ADAPTER implements

invariants: unverified/observed devices expose read-only identity inspection only — no control operations
supported_operations may only contain operations with an implemented adapter on this host

example.verification_evidence: CameraX binds the device; BlindAidManager runs the EfficientDet-Lite2 detector on live frames
example.discovery_evidence: CameraX camera selector enumerates the front camera
